Allow.Retrieval.ready_bounds: ∀ {n : Nat} {t : Allow.TargetContext} {pos neg : List Allow.Retrieval.Member}, Allow.Retrieval.ready n t pos neg → 3 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 5
Allow.Retrieval.ready_positive_size: ∀ {n : Nat} {t : Allow.TargetContext} {pos neg : List Allow.Retrieval.Member}, Allow.Retrieval.ready n t pos neg → pos.length = n
Allow.Retrieval.ready_negative_size: ∀ {n : Nat} {t : Allow.TargetContext} {pos neg : List Allow.Retrieval.Member}, Allow.Retrieval.ready n t pos neg → neg.length = n
Allow.Retrieval.ready_positive_distinct: ∀ {n : Nat} {t : Allow.TargetContext} {pos neg : List Allow.Retrieval.Member}, Allow.Retrieval.ready n t pos neg → (List.map (fun m => m.witness.fullInstanceHash) pos).Nodup
Allow.Retrieval.ready_negative_distinct: ∀ {n : Nat} {t : Allow.TargetContext} {pos neg : List Allow.Retrieval.Member}, Allow.Retrieval.ready n t pos neg → (List.map (fun m => m.witness.fullInstanceHash) neg).Nodup
Allow.Retrieval.ready_positive_admitted: ∀ {n : Nat} {t : Allow.TargetContext} {pos neg : List Allow.Retrieval.Member} {m : Allow.Retrieval.Member}, Allow.Retrieval.ready n t pos neg → m ∈ pos → Allow.Retrieval.admitted t Allow.Polarity.positive m
Allow.Retrieval.ready_negative_admitted: ∀ {n : Nat} {t : Allow.TargetContext} {pos neg : List Allow.Retrieval.Member} {m : Allow.Retrieval.Member}, Allow.Retrieval.ready n t pos neg → m ∈ neg → Allow.Retrieval.admitted t Allow.Polarity.negative m
Allow.Retrieval.below_range_not_ready: ∀ {n : Nat} {t : Allow.TargetContext} {pos neg : List Allow.Retrieval.Member}, n < 3 → ¬Allow.Retrieval.ready n t pos neg
Allow.Retrieval.above_range_not_ready: ∀ {n : Nat} {t : Allow.TargetContext} {pos neg : List Allow.Retrieval.Member}, 5 < n → ¬Allow.Retrieval.ready n t pos neg
Allow.Retrieval.partial_not_ready: ∀ {n : Nat} {t : Allow.TargetContext} {pos neg : List Allow.Retrieval.Member}, pos.length < n → ¬Allow.Retrieval.ready n t pos neg
Allow.Retrieval.positive_query: ∀ (f p : Bool), Allow.Retrieval.queryEval Allow.Polarity.positive f p = (f && p)
Allow.Retrieval.negative_query: ∀ (f p : Bool), Allow.Retrieval.queryEval Allow.Polarity.negative f p = (f && !p)
Allow.Retrieval.opposite_polarities_disj: ∀ (f p : Bool), ¬(Allow.Retrieval.queryEval Allow.Polarity.positive f p = true ∧ Allow.Retrieval.queryEval Allow.Polarity.negative f p = true)
Allow.Retrieval.finite_samples_incomplet: (∀ (x : Bool), x ∈ [false] → (fun _x => false) x = (fun x => x) x) ∧ ¬∀ (x : Bool), (fun _x => false) x = (fun x => x) x
Allow.Retrieval.opposing_witness_refutes: ∀ {α : Type} (p q : α → Bool) (x : α), p x = true → q x = false → ¬∀ (y : α), p y = q y
Allow.Retrieval.pack4_context: ∀ (a b c d : Allow.Retrieval.Block) (i : Fin 768), Allow.Retrieval.pack4 a b c d (Allow.Retrieval.index0 i) = a i
Allow.Retrieval.pack4_predicate: ∀ (a b c d : Allow.Retrieval.Block) (i : Fin 768), Allow.Retrieval.pack4 a b c d (Allow.Retrieval.index1 i) = b i
Allow.Retrieval.pack4_positive: ∀ (a b c d : Allow.Retrieval.Block) (i : Fin 768), Allow.Retrieval.pack4 a b c d (Allow.Retrieval.index2 i) = c i
Allow.Retrieval.pack4_negative: ∀ (a b c d : Allow.Retrieval.Block) (i : Fin 768), Allow.Retrieval.pack4 a b c d (Allow.Retrieval.index3 i) = d i
Allow.Retrieval.score_bounded: ∀ (c p n : Nat), c ≤ 1000 → p ≤ 1000 → n ≤ 1000 → Allow.Retrieval.score c p n ≤ 1000
Allow.Retrieval.commit_current: ∀ {current result : Allow.Retrieval.Snapshot} {complete : Bool}, Allow.Retrieval.commit current result complete = true → current = result ∧ complete = true
Allow.Retrieval.stale_cannot_commit: ∀ {current result : Allow.Retrieval.Snapshot} {complete : Bool}, current ≠ result → Allow.Retrieval.commit current result complete = false
Allow.Retrieval.partial_cannot_commit: ∀ (current result : Allow.Retrieval.Snapshot), Allow.Retrieval.commit current result false = false
Allow.Retrieval.admitted_evidence: ∀ {t : Allow.TargetContext} {p : Allow.Polarity} {m : Allow.Retrieval.Member}, Allow.Retrieval.admitted t p m → m.run.query.target = t ∧ m.run.query.polarity = p ∧ m.witness.ownQuery = m.run.query ∧ m.run.status = Allow.SolverStatus.SAT ∧ m.witness.validated = true
Allow.Retrieval.ready_three_witness: Allow.Retrieval.ready 3 Allow.sampleTarget [Allow.Retrieval.sampleMember Allow.positiveQuery "a", Allow.Retrieval.sampleMember Allow.positiveQuery "b", Allow.Retrieval.sampleMember Allow.positiveQuery "c"] [Allow.Retrieval.sampleMember Allow.negativeQuery "d", Allow.Retrieval.sampleMember Allow.negativeQuery "e", Allow.Retrieval.sampleMember Allow.negativeQuery "f"]
